name: 5 in Non-Stick Micro-Tip Scissors for Sticky Materials, No. 5
bestUse: Best for trimming tape and small paper pieces
descriptionOriginal: A small pair of five-inch scissors with a pointed micro-tip blade and a non-stick coating, made for cutting sticky materials.
whyWeLikeIt: Tape and adhesive gum up ordinary scissors fast, and a fine tip is handy for cutting out small ephemera.
limitations: The scissors are small, so they are not for long cuts or thick card. The coating helps with sticky materials but does not replace wiping the blades.
qualityNote: Customers say the quality is excellent and the blades are sharp and effective. No concerns seen when checked.
